_about: How the Udaipur vendor's lake export maps onto the models. Column names on the left are ours; on the right, the export's. Replace the right-hand names once a real export is available. Units follow the vendor spec: oxygen and turbidity are 0-100%.
_turbidity_percent_to_ntu: Set to [slope, intercept] after measuring a few water samples with a lab turbidimeter beside the sensor; until then turbidity stays on the vendor's % scale.
_timezone: Leave null if the export's timestamps are Udaipur local time. If they are UTC or carry an offset, set "Asia/Kolkata" and they are converted to local time.
